description: ZALF published a six-year, four-field crop-rotation trial at its Müncheberg experimental station in Germany for agro-ecosystem model checking. The 1993–1998 records compare rainfed and irrigated management on sandy soil. CSV tables describe soil water and mineral nitrogen, crop development, biomass, yield, carbon and nitrogen, local weather and field management. The variables were observed at different time intervals, so a modeller must align them before using them as time series. The named public ZALF GeoNode record opened, and DataCite lists CC BY 4.0. The deposit serves calibration and verification of crop growth, water-use and management simulations. It is one station under particular soils and treatments, not a representative sample of German farming. The public page showed no price; no archive or table was downloaded, so column coverage and access to every table remain unverified. A round-one water-sector candidate rejected this same DOI as too site-specific for water infrastructure; this review accepts its separate, documented agricultural-model use. No related catalogue identity match appeared.
